cases.rule: eligible: divergent, admitted retail/airline panel units of the main cells (W4: gptq_w4_d1, awq_w4; KV8: kvq_int8; q4 and q8) whose state passed the QQ no-op replay (QQ branch present and analyze_dev.noop_ok), whose Q pivot replay passed (q_replay all true) and whose three B-involving branches have prefix_ok and env_hash_init_ok. Order: sha256('ghf-case-v1:' + state_id) ascending. Categories in this order: rescue (BQ=1, QQ=0), damage (BQ=0, QQ=1), controller-dependent (Delta_Q != Delta_B); take the first 2 per category, skipping a state already chosen and a (domain, task) already chosen.
